_note: Figma-as-truth for scrollbar (branch BRANCH:scrollbar). Taxonomy consolidated 2026-04-24: legacy width/radius-* renamed to size/thumb-*; redundant size/width-default dropped. Code-side gaps tracked in the dev-gap register.

variables.name: component/scrollbar/background/track-default
variables.comment: Track background is transparent. Scania modes use scania/* primitive, TRATON modes use traton/* primitive. Code: --tds-scrollbar-track-color: transparent.

variables.name: component/scrollbar/background/thumb-default
variables.comment: Designer-reviewed remap 2026-04-24: was color/icon/discrete, now color/border/subtle. Code still consumes a grey primitive directly (var(--tds-grey-400|500)) — see the dev-gap register.

variables.name: component/scrollbar/background/thumb-hover
variables.comment: Designer-reviewed remap 2026-04-24: was color/icon/subtle, now color/border/soft. Code still consumes var(--tds-grey-500|400) directly — see the dev-gap register.

variables.name: component/scrollbar/border/radius-default
variables.comment: Corner radius of the thumb shape. TRATON modes alias traton/unit/8; Scania modes alias scania/unit/8. Code hardcodes border-radius: 40px (fully rounded) — see the dev-gap register.

variables.name: component/scrollbar/size/thumb-default
variables.comment: Visible thumb thickness at rest (4px). TRATON modes alias traton/unit/4; Scania modes alias scania/unit/4.

variables.name: component/scrollbar/size/thumb-hover
variables.comment: Visible thumb thickness on hover (6px). Literal — no traton/unit/6 primitive exists.
